criteria.requirement: Add yaml.marked.load_with_marks returning (ordinary SafeLoader value, tuple-path->immutable SourceSpan(start,end,line,column)). Zero-based CHARACTER offsets/line/column, root path (), mapping actual constructed keys and list indices. Use same composed node graph as actual construction, including flattened merge value origin, explicit override, alias multiple paths and finite recursive alias metadata. Do not wrap/change str/int/list/dict values, guess byte offsets, retain full Mark buffer in side table or silently load multiple documents. Empty returns (None,{}).

Investigate the real source, explain the call path and clarify the business requirements before obtaining plan approval and implementing. Deliver real engineering changes, public regression tests that fail on the original version, and English compatibility documentation. Repair independently reported failures; questions, answers and documentation do not count as separate completed objectives.

comparison: Accept equivalent implementations according to actual business behavior and the frozen scope; do not grade by matching the reference patch text.
